title: Cloud Security: premium rule packages
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for premium rule packages.

## Basis

Premium rule package fee: Enabled premium security rule package; USD per package-month.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Premium rule package fee |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 19 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 19 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 19 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 19 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 19 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 19 |

## Tier comparison

The listed premium rule packages bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
